title: Deque
definition: A double-ended queue (deque) allows insertion and deletion from both ends.
intuition: Combines features of stacks and queues for bidirectional access.
how_it_works: Implemented with doubly linked lists or dynamic arrays, offering O(1) front/back ops.
when_to_use: For sliding window problems, palindrome checkers, or undo-redo histories.
when_not_to_use: When simple queue/stack behavior is sufficient.
content: A double-ended queue (deque) allows insertion and deletion from both ends.
